d: The General Manager is the senior executive responsible for leading Pramac’s joint venture with A. Juffali & Brothers in the Gulf Region. Reporting directly to the Regional General Manager for APAC & Middle East, the General Manager will have full accountability for driving business development, managing sales operations, and overseeing the industrial and financial performance of the local manufacturing operations. The role is focused on expanding the business in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain while ensuring operational excellence and sustainable growth.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, or a related field
Proven experience in business development, sales management, and operational leadership within an industrial or manufacturing environment
Strong knowledge of the power generation industry, including diesel and gas generator sets
Demonstrated ability to manage P&L and complex business operations
Strong strategic thinking and commercial acumen
Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills
Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, quality systems, and regulatory compliance
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build and scale organizations
r: Define and execute the commercial strategy for Saudi Arabia and Bahrain with a strong focus on market growth and customer acquisition
Build, lead, and develop the local sales organization and channel partner network
Position the “Made in Saudi” product portfolio and integrate imported solutions into a unified commercial offering
Lead the setup and operational management of the Bahrain manufacturing facility, ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and efficiency standards
Manage full Profit & Loss responsibility across sales and production operations
Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, supply chain, and quality teams to align production capacity with market demand
Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across all areas of the business
